prompt: A lighthouse on a stormy cliff: climb to the lamp and light it before the ship crashes

intent.setting: A weathered stone lighthouse perched on a storm-torn cliff, the tower interior lit only by lanterns, the lamp room at the top, a ship battering against the rocks far below with crashing fog and waves.
intent.role: You are the lighthouse keeper scrambled to wake as the light has gone out.
intent.goal: Climb the spiral stair inside the lighthouse tower, collect or craft the necessary fuel/flare parts, reach the lamp room, and ignite the beacon before the timer runs out and the ship hits the rocks.
intent.fail: The lamp is still dark when the ship is seen smashing against the cliffs, ending the story.
intent.mood: Tense, urgent, atmospheric with moments of relief on seeing the beam light up
intent.headline: Spiral stair ascent must be climbed in time to light the beacon before the ship timer hits zero.
